# Chapter I - Preliminary {#c1}

## 1. Short Title and Commencement {#p1}

1. These Directions shall be called the Fixture Direction - Customer Due Diligence, 2016.

2. These Directions shall come into effect on the day they are placed on the official website.

# Chapter II - Small Accounts {#c2}

## 3. Small Accounts {#p3}

3. A regulated entity may open a small account for an individual who does not possess an officially valid document, subject to the following conditions:

(a) the aggregate of all credits in a financial year does not exceed rupees one lakh;

(b) the aggregate of all withdrawals and transfers in a month does not exceed rupees ten thousand;

(c) the balance at any point of time does not exceed rupees fifty thousand.

4. A small account shall remain operational initially for a period of twelve months, which may be extended by a further twelve months if the holder provides evidence of having applied for an officially valid document.

# Chapter III - Periodic Updation {#c3}

## 5. Periodicity {#p5}

5. Regulated entities shall carry out periodic updation of customer identification data at least once every two years for high risk customers, once every eight years for medium risk customers and once every ten years for low risk customers.
